Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Gwyedd performs an undirected action. Minion A attempts to block. Gwyedd plays Tangle Atropo's Hand at tem.

Is minion A tapped?

Useful link:http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/f8fc445de7734e84

The action hasn't reached resolution, but do any "after resolution" effect trigger?

Name: Gwyedd
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Gangrel
Group: 4
Capacity: 10
Discipline: tem ANI DEM FOR POT PRO
Camarilla primogen: When Gwyedd is performing an undirected action, any younger vampire who attempts to block and fails is tapped after resolution.

Name: Tangle Atropos' Hand
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Temporis/Potence
Only usable when a minion is attempting to block.
[pot] Cancel the action and untap the acting minion. (The blocking minion is not tapped.)
[tem] As [pot] above, and take the action card, if any, back into your hand (discard afterward).
[TEM] As [tem] above, and this vampire gets +1 stealth on his or her next action this turn.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Smaul
Messages.Body: As Adonai I also believe that they are not tapped, the "after resolution" text in Gwyedd's special, let´s it clear, and TAH cancels the action before any resolution.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
Official confirmation from LSJ, if it's needed.

[LSJ 20090211]
>
> > Is Smudge [the would-be blocker] tapped or untapped.
>
> Untapped. Gwyedd's ability only tries to tap Smudge after action resolution, and
> Tangle cancels the action before resolution.
>
